integrity: Proof and verifier are included; finite computation is corroborative and not proof of arbitrary-field claims. Open literature attribution is explicit and no independence or absolute novelty is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional perfect evolution algebras over finite fields only; K-linear, not semilinear, isomorphisms. One-third counts marked tables, not isomorphism classes. The open full Wei–Zou arXiv manuscript was inspected; its journal version was not separately checked. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Exact idempotent-free census and automorphism dichotomy for two-dimensional perfect evolution algebras
